english.title: Company/officer fail to comply with direction to change company name under section 75B
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[a company]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..),]_

that failed to comply with a direction from the Secretary of State under section 76B of the Companies Act 2006 to change its name
english.legislation: Contrary to section 76B(11) and (12) of the Companies Act 2006.

english.notes: Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar for this offence being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006. No criminal proceedings may be commenced against a person in respect of conduct amounting to an offence if the person has already been given a financial penalty by the registrar. Further, no financial penalty may be imposed on a person in relation to conduct amounting to an offence if proceedings in respect of that offence are ongoing or the person has been convicted.
